newsitem.title: ITALY: Injured French pilot flown home from Italy.
newsitem.headline: Injured French pilot flown home from Italy.

text.p: A French pilot who was critically injured when his plane overshot a runway at Florence Airport earlier this week, was flown home on Friday, airline Air Littoral said in a statement.
Jean-Remi Cuculiere fell into a coma after Wednesday's accident, and the France-based Air Littoral said his condition had worsened in recent hours.
Cuculiere returned to France with the co-pilot of the ATR-42 turbo prop plane, Alain Blayes, who received only minor injuries in the crash. Air Littoral did not say exactly where the two were taken.
Five passengers who were also injured in Wednesday's accident were in good condition and two have already been released from the Tuscan city's Careggi Hospital.
Fourteen passengers were on board the flight from the French resort of Nice when it failed to stop at the end of the runway after landing at the small airport in Florence.
The plane broke through a perimeter fence and ploughed on towards a motorway, its nose hitting the highway guard rail.
Italian magistrates have opened an investigation into the accident.
